SELECT * from BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC


--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT ID, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(1)>1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC_WITH_DUP_20230515  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC
--366
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC_WITH_DUP_20230515
--366

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC_WITH_DUP_20230515 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
[APP_LOG]
,[BO_FO_FLAG]
,[CD]
,[DSCP]
,[HAS_ALERT]
,[HAS_PAYEE_MNT]
,[HAS_TXNLIMIT]
,[HELP_FILE]
,[HREF]
,[ID]
,[IMG_HREF]
,[IS_AUDITABLE]
,[IS_AVAILABLE]
,[IS_BASE_FUNC]
,[IS_ENABLE]
,[IS_IMPORT]
,[IS_MENU]
,[IS_MVA]
,[IS_NOTIFIABLE]
,[IS_PRICING]
,[IS_SERVICE]
,[IS_SYSAD]
,[IS_WF]
,[LVL]
,[OVRD_FLAG]
,[PARENT]
,[SEQ_NO]
,[SEQ_NO_CD]
,[TITLE]
,[WF_ROLE_FLAG]
,[isActive]
,[isLatest]
,[BNK_CODE]
,[SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC_WITH_DUP_20230515; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT ID, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC WHERE ISLATEST = 1 GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(1)>1;

--7

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC
--366
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.BOB_TBLFUNC_WITH_DUP_20230515
--366
